title: I'll Be a Dependable Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm walking with Matikanetannhauser when an unexpected voice reaches our ears.
Hrm… A rookie blunder!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh? That voice… Is that…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Director! It is you! What are you doing all alone in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I have a rare day to myself today… so I thought I'd come to this amusement park. However…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Disappointment! It completely slipped my mind how many rides require a guardian to accompany you!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: I had such sky-high expectations for today, so to be forced to withdraw empty-handed is simply… devastating!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mun-mun… Trainer! This is a job for the support squad!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Please rest assured, Director! You have two capable guardians right here!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: What's this?! Are you saying that you'll accompany me?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Many thanks! I shall happily take you up on your kind offer! Now, sally forth! Fun rides await!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, what unfettered emotion! To think the spectacle I've dreamed of is now before my very eyes!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Let's not just stand around! First up is the de rigueur attraction! Onward to the roller coaster!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Seeing her like this, the director seems like any ordinary child, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She reminds me of my brother when he was little… Hm.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I've come to a decision! I'm going to be the director's big sister for today!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: She always does so much for all of us! So Big Sis Machitan is going to look after her and make sure she has a ton of fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No problem! I've been a big sis since the day my lil' bro was born—I'm a pro!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hey, Director! What ride do you want to go on next?

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Let's see! We've done several of the tamer ones, like the Ferris wheel and spinning teacups. Next, I'd like to take on the drop tower!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Got it! Big S—I'll lead the way! I'm pretty sure we want to turn left here…

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Objection! According to that map over there, we need to take the path to the right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh? …Ah, looks like you're right.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Look over there! They have special carrot ice cream! I bet you'd like to try some, wouldn't you, Director?!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… Intriguing! I've no choice but to partake!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, I know, right?! Okay then, I'll go buy you one!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Ack. Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: She tripped over! …A nosebleed?! Quick! Use these tissues!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, blissful satisfaction! Thanks to the two of you, I had a truly splendid day off!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: By the way, Tannhauser, you were very bright and energetic indeed! You made this experience a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe… Oh, it was nothing.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: However… I have one small concern! Be sure to take care of yourself and lead a healthy academic life!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Then, I bid you adieu. I'll never forget the memories we created here today! Farewell!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Hang on a second! She's worried about me?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-how can that be?! I thought I was supposed to be her dependable big sis today!
choice_data_list: I think you made a fine big sister.
I think you made a fine big sister.
It was kind of the opposite…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah… Of course! There's no way someone with over a decade of big sis experience like me could fail. No way… Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: W-well, which is it?! Geez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser is still a ways off from becoming a dependable big sister. …But she makes a pretty good ditzy big sister.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! No way! My pride as an actual big sis is crumbling to dust!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right! And that's the most important thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I had lots of fun too. I hope the three of us get another chance to hang out like that someday.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: And that'll be my chance to really show what a dependable big sis I am!
